meta.name: taskmaster
meta.description:
Codex wrapper plus same-process expect PTY injector
that keeps work moving until an explicit parseable done signal is emitted.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动运行代码并等待完成信号
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在终端中自动执行命令并等待结果
copy.tagline_en: Automate command execution and wait for completion signal
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run commands in terminal and wait for results automatically

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会通过包装器运行 Codex，自动检查任务是否完成。如果未完成，它会自动注入后续消息继续工作，直到输出明确的完成标记。
howto.when: 当 Claude 通过 Codex 执行任务时，每次检测到 task_complete 事件后，如果未发现完成标记，就会自动注入后续消息。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Python 脚本，完成后输出完成标记。
继续完善这个项目，直到所有功能都实现。
say.note: Claude 会自动注入后续消息，直到任务完成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude runs Codex via a wrapper and automatically checks if the task is complete. If not, it injects follow-up messages to continue working until an explicit done token is emitted.
howto.when_en: When Claude executes a task through Codex, after each task_complete event, if the done token is missing, it automatically injects a follow-up message.

say_en.text: Write a Python script and output the completion marker when done.
say_en.note: Claude will keep working until it outputs TASKMASTER_DONE::<session_id>.

say_en.text: Continue improving this project until all features are implemented.
say_en.note: Claude will automatically inject follow-up messages until the task is complete.
